body.message:
I appreciate that you have referred the matter to your finance team. However, I would appreciate a clear timeline for the refund of my outstanding security deposit.

The security deposit of AED 3,000 was paid in full at the commencement of my tenancy, and I note that your team was very prompt in following up to ensure that the deposit was received before I moved into the apartment.

I have now vacated the apartment, and the applicable deductions have already been communicated. Therefore, I would expect the remaining balance of my security deposit to be processed without further delay.

I understand that there may be internal finance procedures, but “as soon as we receive an update” does not provide a clear timeline for when I should expect my money.

Please confirm the exact date by which the remaining security deposit will be refunded.

I would appreciate your prompt attention to this matter and look forward to receiving the refund confirmation.
